owner_instruction: Important rulesets must not be forgotten. Before asking about or analyzing anyone's life, always look at the current merged ruleset index and consider every applicable retained rule family.

activation_contract.trigger: Any person-specific life analysis, including natal/personality interpretation, retrospective life-event analysis, event timing, future timing, name/numerology analysis, or relationship/life-course interpretation.
activation_contract.rule: Every listed family marked must_consider=true must receive one disposition before the analysis is delivered. Development candidates are considered but remain explicitly development evidence.

families.label: Broad source-grounded natal astrology rule library
families.apply_when: Reliable birth date/time/place are available and astrology is relevant to the life question.
families.interpretation_boundary: Use the broader Lilly/Hellenistic/Jyotish source-grounded library as the primary astrology layer on a new person. Preserve contradictions and nulls; overlapping traditions are not independent observations.

families.label: Six-rule owner-fitted astrology signature
families.interpretation_boundary: This model was fitted to Joel. Calculate it as a secondary fingerprint/comparator; never present its score as a generic validated life/personality score for a new person.

families.label: Source-complete frozen numerology method registry
families.apply_when: Birth date or name data are available and numerology can address the question.
families.interpretation_boundary: Do not default silently to one numerology author when another frozen source method is materially applicable. Distinguish author rules, shared arithmetic, development fit, and unsupported combinations.

families.label: Birth-name and actually-used current-name layering
families.apply_when: The person has changed names, uses a nickname/current name, or the question compares possible names.
families.interpretation_boundary: Birth-name core remains primary. Decoz current/minor name means the name actually used to introduce oneself; legal-only unused names do not silently replace that layer.

families.label: Cumulative merged life-event timing candidates
families.apply_when: The question involves dated past events, life periods, event localization, or future timing.
families.interpretation_boundary: Run every candidate whose declared endpoint/scope is applicable. Preserve hits, misses, false peaks, and transfer failures. A strong development match is retained but not upgraded to validation.

families.label: Timing-model causal and false-positive controls
families.apply_when: Any event-timing ruleset is interpreted or compared.
families.interpretation_boundary: Separate broad state detection from exact-day localization, use causal windows for prospective claims, preserve false positives and endpoint morphology, and do not treat background unknown periods as confirmed negatives.

families.label: Current Human Design V4.3/V3.6 research core
families.apply_when: Human Design is part of the requested life/personality analysis or the task explicitly asks for the combined AstroHD/HD layer.
families.interpretation_boundary: Keep engineering validation, human reverse-match validation, forward-blind validation, and relationship validation separate. Do not infer human validity from synthetic recoverability.

update_rule.when_new_strong_ruleset_found: Append or version it in the relevant cumulative registry and add/update this index if it introduces a new family or changes routing.
update_rule.when_ruleset_superseded: Mark supersession explicitly; do not delete historical evidence.
update_rule.when_transfer_fails: Record the miss and retain the frozen version unless explicitly superseded; do not repair it in place.
